heading: Task inbox
subheading: Every message the engines drafted, ranked by priority. Review, edit, and send.

sendDialog.heading: Review & send
sendDialog.fixedTemplateNotice: This is a fixed Meta-approved WhatsApp template. The text can't be edited — only its variables. This is exactly what will be sent:
sendDialog.editableNotice: Edit before sending if you like — your edit is what goes out.
sendDialog.attachmentRemoved: No longer in the engine's assets — it won't be sent

needsTemplate: WhatsApp can only send an approved template, and this task has none. Handle it another way, or dismiss it.

toolbar.pageNote: Engine, channel and kind filters cover every page. Search looks only at the tasks on this page.

filteredEmpty: No tasks on this page match your search.
footnote: A send whose delivery can’t be confirmed moves to Failed. Dry-run drafts stay in their own bucket and are never sent.

approvals.title: Nothing to approve
approvals.text: AI calls and other actions the engines want to run wait here for your approval.

needsAction.title: All caught up
needsAction.text: New messages appear here when an active engine checks in on someone.

sent.title: Nothing sent yet
sent.text: Messages you or the engines send show up here.

failed.title: No failed messages
failed.text: Messages that could not be delivered show up here.

handled.title: Nothing handled yet
handled.text: Tasks you mark done or skip show up here. You can move them back.

dryRun.title: No dry-run drafts
dryRun.text: Start a dry run on an engine to see what it would send, without sending anything.
